# FlareAlignItems

`Flare.Components.FlareAlignItems`

CSS align-items values for flex containers.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Default` | `0` | No modifier class - inherits the component's default alignment. |
| `Stretch` | `1` | Stretch items to fill the cross axis (CSS: stretch). |
| `Center` | `2` | Centre items on the cross axis (CSS: center). |
| `Start` | `3` | Align items to the start of the cross axis (CSS: flex-start). |
| `End` | `4` | Align items to the end of the cross axis (CSS: flex-end). |
| `Baseline` | `5` | Align items along their text baseline (CSS: baseline). |

## Used by components

- `FlareGrid`
- `FlareStack`
